name: AI Business Automation — Healthcare & Clinic Operations Engine

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  a.id AS appointment_id,
  a.tenant_id,
  a.appointment_number,
  a.queue_token,
  a.appointment_date,
  to_char(a.slot_time, 'HH12:MI AM') AS slot_time_formatted,
  a.reminder_2h_sent,
  a.reminder_24h_sent,
  d.name AS doctor_name,
  d.specialty AS doctor_specialty,
  d.room_number,
  c.customer_phone,
  COALESCE(c.full_name, c.push_name, 'Valued Patient') AS patient_name,
  t.name AS clinic_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN a.appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE AND a.reminder_2h_sent = FALSE THEN '2H_REMINDER'
    WHEN a.appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE + 1 AND a.reminder_24h_sent = FALSE THEN '24H_REMINDER'
    ELSE 'NONE'
  END AS reminder_type
FROM public.clinic_appointments a
JOIN public.clinic_doctors d ON d.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND d.id = a.doctor_id
JOIN public.platform_contacts c ON c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND c.id = a.contact_id
JOIN public.platform_tenants t ON t.id = a.tenant_id
WHERE a.status = 'BOOKED'
  AND (
    (a.appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE AND a.reminder_2h_sent = FALSE)
    OR (a.appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE + 1 AND a.reminder_24h_sent = FALSE)
  )
LIMIT 25;

=UPDATE public.clinic_appointments
SET 
  reminder_2h_sent = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.reminder_type }}' = '2H_REMINDER' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_2h_sent END,
  reminder_2h_sent_at = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.reminder_type }}' = '2H_REMINDER' THEN NOW() ELSE reminder_2h_sent_at END,
  reminder_24h_sent = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.reminder_type }}' = '24H_REMINDER' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_24h_sent END,
  reminder_24h_sent_at = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.reminder_type }}' = '24H_REMINDER' THEN NOW() ELSE reminder_24h_sent_at END
WHERE id = '{{ $json.appointment_id }}';

WITH doc_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    d.name AS doctor,
    d.specialty,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'COMPLETED') AS seen,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.fee_pkr) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'COMPLETED'), 0) AS revenue
  FROM public.clinic_doctors d
  LEFT JOIN public.clinic_appointments a ON a.doctor_id = d.id AND a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.specialty
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.clinic_appointments WHERE appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE) AS total_booked,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.clinic_appointments WHERE appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 'COMPLETED') AS total_completed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.clinic_appointments WHERE appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 'CANCELLED') AS total_cancelled,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(revenue), 0) FROM doc_summary) AS total_revenue_pkr,
  COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'doctor', doctor,
      'specialty', specialty,
      'seen', seen,
      'revenue', revenue
    )
  ), '[]'::jsonb) AS doctor_breakdown
FROM doc_summary;
